# EOS port rates in Mbps and Kpps

`port_rates_mbps.out` contains the header and first row of the Arista EOS 4.36.2F manual example for `show interfaces ethernet 1-2 counters rates`. The prompt and second port row are omitted.

[Arista EOS Ethernet Ports](https://www.arista.com/en/um-eos/eos-ethernet-ports?searchword=eos+section+6+2+system+clock+and+time+protocols#show-interfaces-counters-rates)
